acceptance_criteria: A complete event-kind/severity matrix declares each combination valid, invalid, or legacy-only.
Unsupported new events fail before durable enqueue; unsupported legacy events are quarantined with a bounded metadata-only reason and cannot mutate incident state.
Every incident-opening severity recognized by is_incident_alert has the same episode-barrier semantics, or a documented typed exception with tests.
Informational notices are not recovery-dedupe candidates unless their typed variant explicitly represents recovery.
A recovery notification cannot render or persist a contradictory current severity; prior incident severity, if retained, is separately named.
--clear and --event-type clear accept or reject the same field combinations and derive the same default summary.
Dispatcher formatting, incident open or close, dedupe, storm, stale, dead-letter, replay, and metrics consume one normalized classification result.
Schema-v1 migration tests cover critical clear, informational alert, error alert, missing fields, unknown values, duplicate delivery, restart, and replay.
A malformed or contradictory event never authorizes recovery, replay suppression, or a healthy or clear state.
Tests and operator receipts contain only bounded enums, counts, and reserved synthetic identifiers.
blast_radius: BOT ERRORS emission and durable queue ingress; dispatcher formatting, incident open/close state, recovery dedupe and storm behavior; stale, dead-letter, replay, and metrics handling; and operator-facing recovery evidence.
evidence_summary: Exact pinned blobs preserve independent eventType/severity vocabularies, allow both clear spellings to carry critical severity, classify every clear as incident recovery, classify generic informational alerts as recovery-dedupe candidates, and omit error alerts from the recovery episode barrier. A write-free AST-extracted canary reproduced all three contradictory classifier outcomes and the CLI spelling mismatch. Exact changed-file pagination across all 38 open pull requests found no implementation owner; draft PR #2495 collides with dispatcher paths but preserves all five decisive classifier/formatter functions byte-for-byte. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 6e1672766027c16ecb06f5e122b491c0e5a0a83f to 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de to f0ece2d18883a66f04892a46669b3547e5bdf2b1 delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A canonical validator/classifier that rejects contradictory new combinations, quarantines unsupported legacy combinations, and makes the complete cross-product consistent would falsify the surviving defect. This bounded audit did not rerun the 54-test emitter/dispatcher suite because it creates temporary test directories; that suite result remains issue-author evidence rather than independent audit evidence.
impact: Contradictory or stale events can close incident state while displaying paging severity, informational notices can enter recovery-specific dedupe, and error alerts can reopen incidents without establishing the same episode barrier as warning or critical alerts.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read the live issue identity, labels, body hash, and remote main immediately before registry integration or metadata mutation.
Re-enumerate every open pull request changed-file list immediately before assigning an implementation owner, with explicit attention to preservation PR #2495.
Reconcile the envelope-v2 slice with tracker #2447 and draft PR #2451 without expanding #2451 into this owner boundary.
Require RED/GREEN cross-product, schema-v1 quarantine, duplicate delivery, restart, replay, and privacy tests on the exact implementation head.
Keep live queue migration, deployment, restart, and message delivery outside the draft implementation PR.
